about: Paztport v3 conformance vectors. Every case carries all of its inputs; keys and policies are named and defined in this file. Each key's private key is the PKCS#8 DER 302e020100300506032b657004220420 || seed, where seed = SHA-256(utf8("paztport-v3-vector-key:" + name)), and its public key is the SPKI DER export; both are base64url. Each Merkle leaf salt is the first 16 bytes of SHA-256(utf8("paztport-v3-vector-salt:" + route)), and the policy's routes fill the first leaves in order; padding leaf i is SHA-256(utf8("paztport-v3-vector-pad:" + rootId + ":" + i)). This placement and rootId derivation are for the vectors only; real builds use random slots and a random rootId. Ed25519 is deterministic, so the file is reproduced byte for byte. A verify case runs the live verifier `uses` times against one nonce cache of nonceTtlMs and expects the last result; its policyNotAfter is the earliest notAfter of the keyring and root the verifier pins, which `now` must not pass. An offline case runs the offline verifier once: `recordedTs.last` is the recorded time of the last stamp, `rid` the record's rid, `prompt` the run's recorded prompt, and callMaxAgeMs and runMaxAgeMs the age limits; there is no peer, clock or nonce TTL, and `seen` is the set of nonce keys already spent in the record set. A policy's proof is looked up by `proofRoute` (null: no proof). Cases may be added; a recorded answer changes only with a protocol change.
